newsitem.title: USA: Maine to hold hearings Mon. on supplemental budget.
newsitem.headline: Maine to hold hearings Mon. on supplemental budget.

text.p: Members of the Maine legislature's budget writing committee said they plan to start work on Monday on Gov Angus King's proposed $32 million supplemental budget.

Committee members predicted some of the governor's spending plans would encounter opposition, as King wants to put $13 million in a reserve called the rainy day fund but some lawmakers would rather distribute that money as additional school aid.
Another area likely to create controversy is the proposal to continue welfare payments to illegal aliens.

Maine lawmakers who want to cut taxes now can cite Money Magazine, as its latest edition ranks the tax burden by the state among the highest at 46th. Several bills have been introduced in the legislature to cut tax rates and in some cases to totally repeal a tax.
Neighboring New Hampshire has among the lowest tax burdens in the country, ranking third.
